name: little-code-people
description: A C64-style house where your running Claude Code sessions live.
author: agilofinger

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,game -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lcp/bridge" "npm run dev -w @lcp/game"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @lcp/bridge -- --open
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --config hosting/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
